name: workflow-tools
description: Codex planning, independent Claude counsel, explanation, toolbox synchronization, and explicit shipping skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, consult, explain, sync, and ship changes.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Tools packages Claude Counselor for bounded independent planning and code review, Explain Clearly for concise explanations, Deep Planning for adversarial Plan Mode critique, Sync Toolbox for applying the published toolbox to this machine, and Ship Toolbox for explicit validation, commit, push, CI, and local marketplace refresh workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $explain-clearly to answer directly, adapt the depth to my question, and add examples or visuals only when they help.
Use $deep-planning to critique this plan before implementation.
Use $claude-counselor for bounded independent planning and final code review on major work.
Use $ship-toolbox to validate, commit, push, refresh, and verify the current toolbox changes.
Use $sync-toolbox to update this machine from published main and verify the full managed setup.
Review this Plan Mode request for assumptions, risks, and routing.
